title: Beautiful, Flavorful Cookies: Dump-and-Stir Dough, Log Shaping, and Finishes
summary: Lan Lam walks through a practical, flavor-forward approach to cookies built on a simple dump-and-stir dough, two reliable log-shaping methods to produce uniform, sliceable cookies, and flexible finishing options including fruit dust, nuts, and chocolate. The lesson emphasizes flavor versatility (vanilla as a base plus citrus spice, dried fruit, and nuts), shaping techniques that ensure even diameter for uniform cookies, chilling and slicing mechanics, and baking cues. Finishes cover both melted and tempered chocolate (with a faux-tempering walkthrough attributed to Andrea Giri) and decorative toppings like freeze-dried fruit dust to create color and pattern. Throughout, Lan shares several flavor pairings (almond with sour cherries; pistachio with apricot; peppermint mocha mosaic) and notes that full recipes are available on cooksillustrated.com, with links in the description.
